paragraphs.title: Elijah and Elisha on the Way to Their Separation

easy.explanation: Verse 1 says that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
easy.q: From where did Elijah and Elisha begin their journey?

easy.explanation: Elijah said that the LORD had sent him to Bethel, Jericho, and Jordan.
easy.q: Which places did Elijah say the LORD had sent him to visit?

answers: By asking the prophets for help
By striking the waters with his mantle
easy.explanation: Elijah took his mantle, smote the waters, and they were divided.
easy.q: How did Elijah cross the Jordan?

answers: He would not leave his master
He wanted to find the sons of the prophets
He wanted to return to Gilgal
medium.explanation: Elisha repeatedly said, “I will not leave thee.”
medium.q: Why did Elisha continue traveling with Elijah?

answers: “As the LORD liveth... I will not leave thee.”
medium.explanation: Elisha answered with an oath that he would not leave Elijah.
medium.q: What did Elisha say each time Elijah asked him to stay?

answers: They crossed over without wet ground beneath them
medium.explanation: The divided Jordan left dry ground for Elijah and Elisha to cross.
medium.q: What does the KJV phrase “on dry ground” mean in this passage?

answers: They watched the event from a distance
They did not know where Elijah was
challenge.explanation: The sons of the prophets stood to view afar off while Elijah and Elisha stood by Jordan.
challenge.q: What does the presence of the fifty prophets standing “afar off” show?

challenge.explanation: The journey proceeds from Gilgal to Bethel, then Jericho, and finally Jordan.
challenge.q: What is the correct order of the places in the journey?

answers: His loyalty to Elijah until the separation
His desire to lead the prophets
His fear of crossing the Jordan
challenge.explanation: Elisha insists on remaining with Elijah throughout the journey.
challenge.q: What is emphasized by Elisha’s repeated refusal to leave Elijah?

paragraphs.title: Elijah’s Ascension and the Passing of His Spirit to Elisha

answers: A double portion of his spirit
easy.explanation: Elisha asked that a double portion of Elijah’s spirit be upon him.
easy.q: What did Elisha ask Elijah to give him?

answers: A chariot of fire and horses of fire
easy.explanation: A chariot of fire and horses of fire parted them asunder.
easy.q: What separated Elijah and Elisha during the ascension?

easy.explanation: Elisha took up the mantle of Elijah that fell from him.
easy.q: What fell from Elijah as he went up?

answers: Elisha had to find the sons of the prophets
Elisha had to see Elijah being taken away
Elisha had to return to Jericho
medium.explanation: Elijah said the request would be granted if Elisha saw him when he was taken away.
medium.q: What condition did Elijah give concerning Elisha’s request?

answers: He smote the Jordan with Elijah’s mantle
medium.explanation: Elisha struck the waters with the mantle, and the Jordan divided.
medium.q: How did Elisha show that Elijah’s spirit rested upon him?

answers: A greater share of Elijah’s spirit
medium.explanation: Elisha asked for a double portion of Elijah’s spirit.
medium.q: What does “a double portion” mean in this context?

answers: Seeing Elijah taken away was the stated condition
Seeing Elijah caused Elisha to lose the mantle
Seeing Elijah prevented the Jordan from dividing
challenge.explanation: Elijah said the request would be granted if Elisha saw him taken away.
challenge.q: How was Elisha’s seeing Elijah connected to the fulfillment of his request?

answers: The sons of the prophets had left Jericho
challenge.explanation: Elisha used Elijah’s mantle and crossed the Jordan, showing the continuation of the prophetic ministry.
challenge.q: What does Elisha’s crossing the Jordan after Elijah’s ascension suggest?

answers: He cried out and rent his clothes
He sent the prophets to search for Elijah
challenge.explanation: Elisha cried, “My father, my father,” and rent his clothes in two pieces.
challenge.q: What was Elisha’s immediate response to Elijah’s ascension?

paragraphs.title: The Search for Elijah After His Departure

easy.explanation: The sons of the prophets proposed sending men to seek Elijah.
They said there were fifty strong men, and fifty men were sent.
easy.q: How many men were sent to search for Elijah?

easy.explanation: They sought him for three days but found him not.
easy.q: How long did they search for Elijah?

answers: They thought the Spirit of the LORD had carried him elsewhere
They had seen him return to Jericho
Elisha had told them where he was
medium.explanation: They thought the Spirit of the LORD might have cast Elijah upon a mountain or into a valley.
medium.q: Why did the sons of the prophets think Elijah might be found?

answers: They urged him until he was ashamed
medium.explanation: After they urged him, Elisha told them, “Send.”
medium.q: Why did Elisha finally agree to let them search?

answers: They pressed him by asking repeatedly
medium.explanation: The men continued pressing Elisha until he agreed to send them.
medium.q: What does the word “urged” mean in this passage?

answers: Elijah was not found in the places they searched
challenge.explanation: After three days they found Elijah not, confirming Elisha’s knowledge.
challenge.q: What did the unsuccessful search demonstrate?

answers: Elisha knew the search was unnecessary, but they insisted
Elisha knew nothing, but they knew everything
Elisha searched while they remained in Jericho
challenge.explanation: Elisha first told them not to send, but they continued urging him.
challenge.q: What contrast is shown between Elisha and the sons of the prophets?

challenge.explanation: The men came again to Elisha while he tarried at Jericho.
challenge.q: Where was Elisha when the searchers returned?

easy.explanation: The men of the city said that its situation was pleasant.
easy.q: What was pleasant about the city of Jericho?

answers: It was harmful and caused death and barren land
easy.explanation: They said the water was naught and the ground barren.
easy.q: What was wrong with the water of Jericho?

easy.explanation: Elisha asked for a new cruse with salt and cast the salt into the waters.
easy.q: What did Elisha cast into the spring?

medium.explanation: Elisha said, “Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein.”
medium.q: What did Elisha ask the people to bring him?

medium.explanation: Elisha declared, “Thus saith the LORD, I have healed these waters.”
medium.q: What did Elisha declare in the name of the LORD?

answers: Unable to produce or sustain life
medium.explanation: The barren ground was unproductive and associated with death.
medium.q: What does “barren” mean in this passage?

answers: They were healed and no longer caused death
challenge.explanation: The waters were healed according to the saying of Elisha.
challenge.q: What change took place in the waters after Elisha spoke?

answers: They complained about the water, and he treated its spring
They wanted to leave, and he built another city
They requested a mantle, and he tore it
challenge.explanation: Because the water was harmful, Elisha went to the spring and healed it.
challenge.q: What is the connection between the people’s complaint and Elisha’s action?

answers: The waters remained healed through the time described
challenge.explanation: The verse says the waters were healed unto that day.

paragraphs.title: Mockery of Elisha and the Punishment of the Mockers

easy.explanation: The verse says that Elisha went up from there unto Bethel.
easy.q: Where did Elisha go up from Jericho?

easy.explanation: They mocked Elisha by saying, “Go up, thou bald head.”
easy.q: What did the mockers call out to Elisha?

easy.explanation: The KJV says that the bears tare forty and two children.
easy.q: How many children were attacked by the bears?

answers: He cursed them in the name of the LORD
He sent them to search for Elijah
medium.explanation: Elisha turned back, looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the LORD.
medium.q: What did Elisha do after hearing the mockery?

answers: Two she bears came out of the wood
medium.explanation: Two she bears came out of the wood and attacked the children.
medium.q: What happened immediately after Elisha cursed them?

answers: They made fun of and ridiculed him
medium.explanation: The children ridiculed Elisha by repeatedly calling him baldhead.
medium.q: What does “mocked” mean in this passage?

challenge.explanation: Elisha went to Bethel, then to Mount Carmel, and returned to Samaria.
challenge.q: What is the correct sequence of places at the end of the chapter?

answers: After he cursed in the LORD’s name, the bears came out
After he healed the waters, the bears disappeared
After he crossed Jordan, the bears arrived
challenge.explanation: The bears came out after Elisha cursed the mockers in the LORD’s name.
challenge.q: What connection does the passage make between Elisha’s action and the bears?

answers: There were two bears and forty-two children
There were fifty bears and four children
There was one bear and twenty children
challenge.explanation: The verse specifically mentions two she bears and forty-two children.
challenge.q: Which detail about the attack is easy to overlook?
